newsitem.title: USA: Fonar says court upholds ruling against GE.
newsitem.headline: Fonar says court upholds ruling against GE.

text.p: Fonar Corp. said Tuesday that a U.S. Appeals Court upheld a $62 million judgment plus interest against General Electric Co. for infringing on a Fonar patent for a scanning device.
The appeals court reinstated the jury verdict finding infringement of its original patent and awarding $35 million in damages as compensation for that infringement, Fonar said.
Fonar, based in Melville, N.Y., said the ruling affirms that it is the first company to devise magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanning.
A GE spokesman said the company is evaluating the decision and examining the basis for a challenge.

"We are surprised and disappointed by the decision," he said. "We are gratified that the court upheld the finding that GE did not intentionally infringe upon any Fonar patents or induce others to do so."
